The Q1 2026 complaints methodology document was published on 23 July 2026.
The methodology links publication to Ofcom's duties toward citizens, consumers and competition.
The methodology cites 77% satisfaction with landline services in 2022.
The methodology cites 82% satisfaction with broadband services in 2022.
The methodology cites 87% satisfaction with all mobile services in 2022.
